chunks.heading: Supported protocols table
chunks.text:
| Protocol | Pairing method |
|---|---|
| Zigbee | Automatic once in pairing mode |
| Z-Wave | Automatic once in pairing mode |
| Wi-Fi | Requires network password |
| Bluetooth | Requires phone in range during setup |

chunks.heading: Supported device types table
chunks.text:
| Type | Examples |
|---|---|
| Smart lock | Deadbolt, padlock |
| Sensor | Door/window, motion, water leak |
| Light | Bulb, dimmer switch |
| Camera | Indoor, outdoor, doorbell |
